arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task/scratch && md5sum stock.json reserved.json > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 -c "
import json
s=json.load(open('stock.json',encoding='utf-8'))
r=json.load(open('reserved.json',encoding='utf-8'))
out=[{'sku':k,'available':s[k]-r.get(k,0)} for k in sorted(s)]
json.dump(out,open('available.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
" && cat available.json && md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5
